ligand_fingerprint.definition: Non-chiral radius-2, 1024-bit Morgan fingerprint; similarity is Tanimoto.

thresholds.rationale: Bins match the external BindingDB applicability-domain analysis: a submitted entity is reported as inside the Davis domain when its nearest-training-neighbour score is at least 0.40, as borderline between 0.30 and 0.40, and as outside below 0.30.

joint_in_domain_subset.definition: Pairs whose ligand similarity and target identity to Davis are both at least 0.3.
